visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of seven performers stands in a bright indoor hallway in front of silver elevator doors. The group includes four women and three men. The men wear bright blue, yellow, and orange short-sleeved shirts with white accents and white trousers. The women wear red, purple, and orange dresses with white collars and white boots. A central woman wears a long white dress with a black bow. They are smiling and waving at the camera. (2) The group begins a synchronized dance routine. They perform playful hand gestures, such as pointing to their heads, making heart shapes, and swinging their arms in rhythm. The lighting is bright and even studio-style. The camera remains mostly static, capturing the full body and mid-range shots of the performers as they move together. (3) The performance ends with the group cheering and laughing. Some performers move closer to the camera, waving and giving thumbs-up. The central woman in the white dress blows a kiss. The scene concludes with a quick shot of the empty hallway and closed elevator doors.
